name: Shigure
source: On the surface, he's an average person running a fruit store in the suburbs. But he's really a skilled ninja; a "fixer" who will take on any commission. A womaniser, he's on an endless search for the supreme woman for supreme sexual encounters. His supremely-developed physique is used as a weapon, but he also has a hidden power.
